steps: use its cloud copy on their phones

(async () => { const db = await new Promise((r, j) => { const q = indexedDB.open('almari'); q.onsuccess = () => r(q.result); q.onerror = j; }); const n = await new Promise((r) => { const t = db.transaction('files').objectStore('files').count(); t.onsuccess = () => r(t.result); }); return n === 0 ? 'no file copies on the device' : 'EXPECTED no files, found ' + n; })()

(() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="button"]')].find(e => /PAN card/.test(e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.textContent)); if (!el) return 'MISSING PAN row'; el.click(); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('img')].filter(i => i.src.startsWith('blob:') && i.naturalWidth > 0); return imgs.length ? 'photo loaded from the cloud' : 'EXPECTED the photo'; })()

(async () => { const db = await new Promise((r, j) => { const q = indexedDB.open('almari'); q.onsuccess = () => r(q.result); q.onerror = j; }); const n = await new Promise((r) => { const t = db.transaction('files').objectStore('files').count(); t.onsuccess = () => r(t.result); }); return n === 0 ? 'still nothing kept on the device' : 'EXPECTED no files, found ' + n; })()
